final: WITH name_totals AS (SELECT ra.name, SUM(re.points) AS total_points FROM races AS ra JOIN results AS re ON re.raceId = ra.raceId GROUP BY ra.name), above_average AS (SELECT name, total_points FROM name_totals WHERE total_points > (SELECT AVG(total_points) FROM name_totals)) SELECT SUM(a.total_points) AS combined_total_points, (SELECT AVG(CAST(re.laps AS REAL)) FROM races AS ra JOIN results AS re ON re.raceId = ra.raceId JOIN above_average AS a ON a.name = ra.name) AS average_laps_completed, AVG(a.total_points - (SELECT AVG(total_points) FROM name_totals)) AS average_excess_over_average_total FROM above_average AS a
